name: get_route
description: Get the solved route the climber is on: grade, number of moves, which move is the crux, the climber height it was solved for, and every move in order in plain words.

name: get_next_move
description: Get the move the climber should do now: which limb, how big a reach it is for them, where the hold is relative to their body, which hold (with landmarks like 'the jug your hands started on'), any foot moves first, whether it is the crux (with short tips), and two or three ready phrasings. how_far gives metres, for when the climber asks. Set climber_finished_last_move to true when the climber has just completed the move you last called, so the coach moves on to the following one.

climber_finished_last_move.description: True if the climber says they completed the last move you called. False if they are asking again, asking for a repeat, or have not started yet.

restart.description: True to start again from the first move, for example after a fall. Defaults to false.

name: set_climber_height
description: Re-solve the route for a climber of a different height and return the new route. Use when the climber tells you their height or asks how the route changes for a taller or shorter climber. Restarts coaching from the first move.

height_m.description: Climber height in metres, between 1.2 and 2.2. Convert from feet and inches or centimetres if the climber says it that way.
